facts.fact: The policy says the Ghana National Household Registry, run under the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection, is used to identify and verify eligible beneficiaries for government programmes.
The policy says registry data is used to identify eligible beneficiaries for programmes such as LEAP, NHIS and school feeding.
The policy says the registry collects the NIA Ghana Card number and links registry data with NIA, NHIA and GES databases.
